rv.q: Fifteen years after its Broadway debut, The Book of Mormon remains one of the funniest musicals ever written.
This cast makes it all look so fun.
The cast is great, especially understudy Rayna J. who played Nabulungi on June 2nd, her strong beautiful voice working perfectly in the goofy ballads given to her.
A show filled with satire and catchy tunes has set up shop at the Arts Center this week, featuring a talented cast ready to say "Hello!" to Nashville audiences.

cn.t: Critics praise "The Book of Mormon" for balancing irreverent humor with surprising depth, noting its hummable score and meaningful messages still resonate powerfully beneath the shock value fifteen years after its debut.
